g.title: PMU16_EWP_STUB
g.text: Stub: PMU16 O5+O14 parallel → CWA400 Pin 3

O5 and O14 wired in parallel -- join at CWA400 Pin 3 terminal. Combined 50A rating handles CWA400 35.5A nominal draw. 8 AWG per wire minimum. Configure as parallel pair in PMU software. PMU16 M6 stud is BATT+ always-on -- O5+O14 can activate post key-off for cooling soak without a separate BATT+ relay or power-hold relay. See power-distribution.wv for upstream wiring (BATT+, ANL fuse, PMU16 stud).

g.title: CABLE_PWR_O5
g.text: CWA400_PUMP:3:Pin 3 (+12V power -- from PMU16 O5+O14 parallel)
PMU16 O5 to CWA400 Pin 3 (parallel A). 8 AWG minimum. Route from PMU16 through engine bay to pump location. Join to CABLE_PWR_O14 at Pin 3 terminal (parallel junction).

g.title: CABLE_PWR_O14
g.text: CWA400_PUMP:3:Pin 3 (+12V power -- from PMU16 O5+O14 parallel)

PMU16 O14 to CWA400 Pin 3 (parallel B). 8 AWG minimum. Route alongside CABLE_PWR_O5 -- keep both runs the same length to balance current sharing between the two parallel outputs. Join to CABLE_PWR_O5 at Pin 3 terminal (parallel junction).

g.title: CWA400_PUMP
g.text: 150 LPM @ 0.85 bar -- installed in lower radiator hose
Pin 1 (PWM signal in -- from MaxxECU GPO)
Pin 3 (+12V power -- from PMU16 O5+O14 parallel)

PWM version ONLY: Pierburg 7.07223.10.0 / BMW 11515A05704 / 11517563659. Do NOT use LIN version (Pierburg 7.03665.66.0 / BMW 11517604027). Connector: Kostal 2+2 (10098866). Pins 1-2: SLK 2.8 ELA terminals (22124499560). Pins 3-4: SLK 5.8 ELA terminals (22124544900). Install inline in lower radiator hose (cold/return side), outlet toward engine. Pin 2 (BSD): leave floating -- not used with MaxxECU PWM control. 35.5A nominal draw -- 8 AWG minimum on Pin 3 (PMU16 O5+O14 parallel feeds here). Datasheet: https://tecomotive.com/download/datasheets/CWA400_PWM_EN.pdf Product: https://www.tecomotive.com/en/products/CWA400_PWM.html

g.title: CABLE_GND
g.text: CWA400 Pin 4 to chassis ground stud. 10 AWG minimum. Dedicated ground -- do not share.

g.title: CHASSIS_GND
g.text: Dedicated ground for pump Pin 4 -- do not share with signal grounds or high-current grounds from other loads (fan motor, fuel pump). 10 AWG minimum. Ring terminal, solid bolt to body metal.

g.title: MAXXECU_GPO
g.text: MaxxECU RACE -- PWM General Purpose Output
GPO pin TBD -- confirm in MaxxECU pin assignment

MaxxECU GPO configured as PWM output at 680 Hz. CLT-to-duty-cycle map: 20% at 60C / 55% at 85C / 97% at 105C. MaxxECU GPO high = 12V; CWA400 requires V_Hi at least 0.6 x Ub (~7.2V) -- compliant. Wake pulse: MaxxECU must output at least 3ms uninterrupted high at ignition-on before transitioning to CLT map -- configure startup duty override in software. Duty cycle 0-12%: pump off or emergency run -- do not use in normal map. Duty cycle 13-85%: controlled operation (linear min to max speed). Duty cycle 86-97%: full speed. 98-100%: emergency run (~5900 RPM).

g.title: CABLE_PWM
g.text: CWA400_PUMP:1:Pin 1 (PWM signal in -- from MaxxECU GPO)

MaxxECU GPO to CWA400 Pin 1 (PWM signal). 22 AWG signal wire. Route from ECU through firewall grommet to pump. Keep away from ignition coil wiring and high-current runs where possible. Shielded wire preferred for EMC -- drain to chassis GND at ECU end only.
